name: WebExtract API
description: Web page to clean Markdown + fixed-schema structured JSON for AI agents. robots.txt respected. Free tier is opt-in: send X-Billing: free (or ?free=1) for 20 calls/day per IP. Requests with no key, no payment and no opt-in get HTTP 402 Payment Required (reason x402_required); X-Billing: x402 does the same explicitly. MCP (/mcp) keeps 20 free calls/day per IP without a header. Credits never expire. No charge on failed fetches (404, timeout, blocked, robots.txt disallowed). Structured JSON at no extra cost: /v1/extract = 1 credit, /v1/markdown = 0.4 credit. If structured fields come back empty, you're only charged the Markdown rate. Prepaid packs $1=200 credits, $5=1000 credits, $20=5000 credits, $50=15000 credits via https://webextract.dev/#pricing (Authorization: Bearer <key>). Or pay per call without an account via x402 v2: /v1/extract $0.005, /v1/markdown $0.002 in USDC on Base (recommended), Polygon, Arbitrum One, World Chain, Monad, Avalanche C-Chain or OP Mainnet (eip155:8453, eip155:137, eip155:42161, eip155:43114, eip155:10, eip155:480, eip155:143); send the signed payload in the PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header; x402 settles at the quoted price and only when the request succeeds. Sandbox for testing x402 clients: same endpoints under /sandbox/v1/* or with X-Billing: x402-testnet, Base Sepolia (eip155:84532) test USDC only, free test money, rate limited. JS rendering (headless browser, JavaScript executed, ports 80/443 only, one render at a time per client): /v1/render/extract = 1.6 credits or $0.008 x402, /v1/render/markdown = 0.8 credits or $0.004 x402; 5 free renders/day per IP with X-Billing: free (separate from the 20/day free tier); sandbox under /sandbox/v1/render/* or X-Billing: x402-testnet. Failed renders are not charged.
